notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard joined-federate HLAobjectInstancesRegistered and HLAobjectInstancesUpdated MOM attributes. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM declarations, HLAsetTiming, HLAinteger32BE, HLAbyte, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application object/attribute names. The test verifies direct Request Attribute Value Update values across successful registration and update service boundaries, the distinct-object update count, the companion HLAupdatesSent count, periodic HLAsetTiming reflection, callback metadata, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM attribute lookup, subscription, direct update request, object registration and attribute update, standard HLAsetTiming interaction, with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador MOM, object, attribute, interaction, and data-element declarations
